name: context-bar
description: The session's context window as a bar in the footer, with a mark where auto-compact kicks in: green, amber as it nears the compact, red right before it.

warnPoints.title: Amber this close to the compact
warnPoints.description: Points of the window left before auto-compact at which the bar turns amber.

dangerPoints.title: Red this close to the compact
dangerPoints.description: Points of the window left before auto-compact at which the bar turns red.
